faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.booking.1.q: How do I book a transfer?
faq.booking.1.a: Enter your pickup, destination, date and time in the search form, choose a car, add the lead passenger's details, then pay. You'll get a booking reference straight away.
faq.booking.2.q: What pickup time should I choose?
faq.booking.2.a: For an airport arrival, choose your flight's landing time and add your flight number. For a hotel or address pickup, choose the time you want to leave, and allow extra time for traffic when heading to the airport.
faq.booking.3.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.booking.3.a: Pickups can be booked from 3 hours ahead. Booking earlier gives you the widest choice of cars.
faq.booking.4.q: How do I know my booking is confirmed?
faq.booking.4.a: Your ride is confirmed when Waydidi issues a booking reference and the confirmation page shows your journey details. A confirmation email follows.
faq.booking.5.q: Can I book for someone else?
faq.booking.5.a: Yes. Enter the lead passenger's name and a phone number that works on the day, and keep the booking reference handy.
faq.conditions.1.q: What if my luggage does not fit?
faq.conditions.1.a: Choose a car that matches both your passengers and your bags; each car shows how many it carries. Contact support before travel for oversized items, sports gear or extra bags.
faq.conditions.2.q: Can I add a child seat?
faq.conditions.2.a: Yes, for THB 300 per seat. Tap the + button next to Continue after choosing your car and add the number of child seats you need.
faq.conditions.3.a: Tap the ? on any car to see exactly what's included for your route. Tolls are included on selected routes and listed under Excluded on the others.
faq.changes.1.q: Can I change the date or time?
faq.changes.1.a: Eligible bookings can request a date or time change from Manage booking until three days before pickup. Changes depend on availability.
faq.changes.2.a: Email support@waydidi.com with your booking reference. Requests received at least 24 hours before pickup are cancelled free of charge with a full refund.
faq.payment.1.a: Pay online by card, PromptPay, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or choose cash and pay your driver on the day.
faq.payment.2.q: Which currency will I be charged in?
faq.payment.2.a: Prices can be shown in your chosen currency, but every booking is charged in Thai baht (THB).
faq.payment.3.q: How do I use a promo code?
faq.payment.3.a: Enter the code in the Promo code box on the payment step and tap Apply. The discount shows before you pay.
faq.meeting.1.q: Where will I meet my driver at the airport?
faq.meeting.1.a: Your confirmation shows the pickup instructions. Keep your phone on after landing, as the exact meeting point can vary by terminal.
faq.meeting.2.a: When you add a valid flight number, we use it to follow arrival changes. Please still tell us about major itinerary changes.
faq.meeting.3.q: How do I check my ride?
faq.meeting.3.a: Open Manage booking and enter your booking reference together with the verification details requested.

faq.meeting.4.q: How long will my driver wait?
faq.meeting.4.a: Airport pickups include 60 minutes of free waiting after your flight lands, even if it's delayed. Other pickups include 15 minutes of free waiting.
